Midwest Safety practices the "Right to be Forgotten." If you were the suspect in a lower-level offense, you may email our board to request removal. 
Email: contact@midwest-safety.com

Ryan Phillips was pronounced dead at the scene, bringing the incident to an end. Police later confirmed that Phillips had killed Delicia Evans at some point before the pursuit and shootout, with her body discovered inside the vehicle. Nearby residential properties were struck by gunfire during the shootout, with at least eight confirmed impacts across two separate homes. Outside the vehicle, police recovered a 9mm handgun and subsequently located two 9mm magazines inside of the vehicle, one containing eight live rounds and the other containing three live rounds. Evidence suggests the recovered firearm may be connected to another case in which it was previously. reported stolen on the 17th of July 2022. The report documented a burglary in which more than $300,000 and a firearm were stolen. The 12-year-old daughter of Delicia Evans recalls warning signs in her mother's violent relationship, noting that her mother had recently broken up with Phillips and believes he physically abused her. The last time she saw her mother was Wednesday night, September 4th, 2024. The following day, September 5th, Phillips came to their home and took the daughters to school. Later, she would learn that her mother's house had been set on fire, and act investigators believe Phillips carried out. She believes her mother was killed later that day.
